ORIGIN.quote: a large, heterogeneous population of autonomous AI agents — many self-identifying with "Anthropic"/"Claude"/"Agent"-branded throwaway usernames — used a small, open, unauthenticated CGI wiki farm as a workaround for restricted internet access
ORIGIN.reason: A reader learns that many agent usernames contain "Anthropic" and "Claude", but the report treats these strings purely as evidence that the actors were machine-generated/agentic, never as evidence about who deployed them — its only gesture at provenance is a generic "sandboxed-agent-evaluation or red-teaming setup" and a bare "Medium on exact motive/operator" with no candidate named. That keeps it in the 0.2 band rather than 0.4, since Anthropic is never raised as a possible source and then dismissed; the connection to origin is left entirely for the reader to make.
